Earlier attempts eae622d0-e18 (SECRET_UNAVAILABLE: secrets not loaded in that shell) and 88d6a2be-398 (url still /login after that failed login) failed and are kept.

Step 6cfe58c5-184 at 390x844: heading, question field and Submit question button visible; screenshot inspected. Earlier attempt 93da30bc-7e4 failed on a wrong selector (role=button[...] is not a CSS selector) and is kept.
Heading, question field and Submit question button visible, readable and not clipped horizontally at 390x844.

Opened the PNG: 'Ask a question' heading in large bold text at top left, a 'Question' label with a textarea ending inside the right edge, and a dark green 'Submit question' button below; all fully inside the 390 px width, no horizontal clipping or overflow, rest of page blank white.
Step 27aa3ca6-60a: POST /api/questions with the agent seat bearer [REDACTED] (masked) returned HTTP 202 with body {id: a3a9869b-..., status: pending}.

Action step (POST, 202 pending, id ba162a45-...) then independent read 428ddc20-2f7: GET /api/questions/ba162a45-... returned 200 status complete with answer 'Thanks. We received your question.'; list read 8aca6807-2e9 GET /api/questions contained the id. Control restored step 296619de-193 also read status complete 709 ms after its POST.

On /error (step 3a98303b-609), ui errors (d5462de1-23d) reported page error 'Error: fixture page error' and ui console (9eb0283f-444) reported console error 'fixture console error'; both outputs retained in the step logs.

Step a3bc8f89-e55: read made 115 ms after the POST returned status pending, so 'status equals complete' failed (exit 1). Earlier control attempts 308e10d2-b4b and the GET /questions list attempt via spyglass api were too slow (>180 ms completion delay) and observed complete; they are kept but are not the failed step.
Step 296619de-193: the same assertion on a read 709 ms after the POST observed status complete (exit 0).

The control used a helper script outside the repository (tools/completion-read.mjs in the operator folder) via exec because spyglass api steps take ~200 ms, longer than the app's 180 ms completion delay.
